end_plate.doc: End plate: the 10 mm aluminium plate at each end of the bridge beams, bolted to an MGN15 carriage on its post.

galvo_spacer.doc: Galvo spacer: an aluminium block between the laser plate and the galvo, putting the galvo's input on the beam axis.

laser_plate.doc: Laser plate: 10 mm aluminium (waterjet cut) under the two bridge beams, carrying the UV source and the galvo in line.

motor_mount.doc: Motor mount: a 6 mm aluminium plate a NEMA 17's face bolts to (pilot in its 22 bore), standing on or hung from

z_ear.doc: Z ear: the aluminium block on the -y side of each end plate that carries the Tr8x8 flange nut of that post's

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: tightest 0.100 mm between t8_nut_1 and z_screw_1 at z = -10.0 mm (285 moving pairs)
rows.limit: no overlap, and every declared clearance held
rows.source: 7 poses across -10.0 to +10.0 mm. Axes are swept one at a time from home, so a crash needing two axes off-home is not covered.

rows.subject: axis z
rows.measured: tool reaches -10.0 to +10.0 mm, work area -10.0 to +10.0 mm (+0.0 mm margin)
rows.source: tool point swept along the axis over declared travel; this is kinematic reach, not whether the head can physically get there without hitting something — that is the sweep rule

rows.subject: pose focus_high
rows.limit: every axis declared in AXES, each position inside its travel
rows.source: POSES and AXES in assembly.py

rows.subject: pose focus_low
rows.limit: every axis declared in AXES, each position inside its travel
rows.source: POSES and AXES in assembly.py

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: 850.0 × 40.0 mm across 2 bodies at z = -100.01 (bridge_post_1, bridge_post_2)
rows.limit: at least 5 mm in both axes
rows.source: union of the contact patches at the lowest plane; a span near zero in either axis is a line or point contact and will tip. Does not test the centre of mass.

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: 2 bodies on the plane, 25 above it, none below
rows.source: the lowest plane is taken as the ground, so nothing can be below it by construction; this row records the split

rows.subject: assembly
rows.measured: no mass for 6 of 27 bodies: t8_nut_1 (bought part 't8_nut' declares no mass_g with a mass_source); t8_nut_2 (bought part 't8_nut' declares no mass_g with a mass_source); z_coupling_1 (bought part 'coupling' declares no mass_g with a mass_source); z_coupling_2 (bought part 'coupling' declares no mass_g with a mass_source); z_screw_1 (bought part 't8_screw' declares no mass_g with a mass_source); z_screw_2 (bought part 't8_screw' declares no mass_g with a mass_source)
rows.source: made: volume x density of its MATERIAL; bought: declared mass_g with a mass_source; a stock body has none
